goal_intent: book Saturday lunch for four, two of them children

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m ringing to see if you have any tables for lunch this Saturday — we’re planning a little family get-together and hoping to eat out for a change.
Thanks for asking! There will be four of us altogether — we’re looking forward to a nice catch-up over lunch.
We’re hoping for 1pm, if you have something around then. That way the kids won’t get too hungry before we arrive!
Absolutely, you can put it under Dermot Whelan. By the way, two of us are little ones, so we’ll need a couple of high chairs at the table if that’s possible!
No, that’s everything, thanks a million! We’re really looking forward to it. Have a great day! [END OF CALL]
